svg.title: Agent Work Board architecture
svg.desc: Agents' shells call the awb CLI, which takes a lock and atomically renames data/board.json. server.mjs watches data/ and pushes each change over server-sent events to the board page, shown in the Mac app's WKWebView or a browser. A LaunchAgent keeps the server running; usage.mjs reads Claude Code transcripts and sends aggregates only. Everything stays on this Mac on 127.0.0.1; no model calls.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Agents post with one command; a local server pushes every change to each open window.
